kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-proxy-endpoint --db-instance-id rm-bp1ja4f56s7us0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou

DBProxyFeatures.description_en:
The feature settings of the proxy endpoint. The value is a string of semi-colon delimited key-value pairs. The string contains the following keys:

TransactionReadSqlRouteOptimizeStatus: Specifies whether to enable transaction splitting. Valid values: 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled).

ConnectionPersist: Specifies the connection pool type. Valid values: 0 (disabled), 1 (session-level connection pool), and 2 (transaction-level connection pool).

ReadWriteSpliting: Specifies whether to enable read/write splitting. Valid values: 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled).

AZProximityAccess: The nearby access feature. Valid values: 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled).

CausalConsistRead: Specifies the read consistency level. Valid values: 0 (eventual consistency), 1 (session consistency), and 2 (global consistency).

HtapFilter: The automatic routing of HTAP requests. Valid values: 0 (disabled) and 1 (enabled).

PinPreparedStmt: a reserved internal parameter that is visible only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances.

For ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances, you can modify only the ReadWriteSpliting setting. The TransactionReadSqlRouteOptimizeStatus and PinPreparedStmt keys are permanently set to 1
DBProxyFeatures.description_zh:
代理终端的设置信息，格式为JSON，包含下述参数：
TransactionReadSqlRouteOptimizeStatus：事务拆分设置，取值为0（关闭）或1（开启）。
ConnectionPersist：连接池设置：取值为0（关闭）、1（会话级连接池）或2（事务级连接池）。
ReadWriteSpliting：读写分离设置，取值为0（关闭）或1（开启）。
AZProximityAccess：就近访问，取值为 0（关闭）或 1（开启）。
CausalConsistRead：读一致性设置：取值为0（最终一致性）、1（会话一致性）或2（全局一致性）。
HtapFilter：HTAP行列自动分流，取值为 0（关闭）或 1（开启）。
PinPreparedStmt：仅RDS PostgrSQL可见，内部参数。

RDS PostgreSQL仅支持修改ReadWriteSpliting，TransactionReadSqlRouteOptimizeStatus和PinPreparedStmt默认为1

ReadOnlyInstanceDistributionType.description_en:
The read weight distribution mode. For more information, see [Read weight allocation]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96076.html）. Valid values:

Standard: The system automatically allocates read weights to instances based on their specifications.

Custom: You specify custom read weights for instances
ReadOnlyInstanceDistributionType.description_zh:
读权重分配模式，详情请参见[读权重分配]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96076.html）。取值：

Standard：按规格权重自动分配。
Custom：自定义分配权重

ReadOnlyInstanceMaxDelayTime.description_en: The latency threshold for read/write splitting. If the replication latency on a read-only instance exceeds this threshold, read requests are not routed to the instance. Unit: seconds
ReadOnlyInstanceMaxDelayTime.description_zh: 读写分离的延迟阈值，当只读实例延迟时间超过该阈值时，读取流量不发往该实例，单位：秒

ReadOnlyInstanceWeight.description_en:
The read weight distribution. The value is a JSON string that specifies the read weights of the primary and read-only instances. It contains the following fields:

DBInstanceId: The instance ID.

DBInstanceType: The instance type. Valid values: Master (primary instance) and ReadOnly (read-only instance).

NodeID: The ID of the primary or secondary node of the primary instance if the instance runs RDS Cluster Edition.

NodeType: The node type of an instance that runs RDS Cluster Edition. Valid values: Primary (primary node) and Secondary (secondary node).

Weight: The read weight of the instance. The value increases in increments of 100, with a maximum value of 10000
ReadOnlyInstanceWeight.description_zh:
读权重分配信息，即传入主实例和只读实例的读请求权重，格式为JSON，包含下述参数：
DBInstanceId：实例ID。
DBInstanceType：实例类型，取值为Master（主实例）或ReadOnly（只读实例）。
NodeID：集群系列中主实例主节点和备节点的节点ID。
NodeType：集群系列中的节点类型，取值为Primary（主实例-主节点）或Secondary（主实例-备节点）。
Weight：读请求权重，以100递增，最大值为10000
